value: US EPA Natural Gas STAR Program (2003-2011). Lessons Learned studies (series of 18 used here: directed inspection and maintenance at compressor stations, gas processing plants and gate stations (2003); instrument air, plunger lift, vapour recovery units, glycol circulation and flash tanks, pneumatic device options, compressors off-line, rod packing, electric glycol pumps, desiccant dehydrators, dry seals, pipeline pump-down (2006); removing accumulated fluid from gas wells (2011); composite wrap and hot taps (2006) and reduced emission completions (2011), added 2026-10-03). Washington, DC: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Retrieved from the 19 January 2017 snapshot of epa.gov (19january2017snapshot.epa.gov/natural-gas-star-program/recommended-technologies-reduce-methane-emissions_.html), 2026-10-02.

One extraction for the series; each row's reference starts with the PDF file stem, then the page. Each document has an Economic and Environmental Benefits box (gas saved, implementation cost, O&M, payback at $3/$5/$7 per Mcf) and worked examples. Loaded: description, state-of-development, capex (per installation: compressor, seal, device, facility, well, dehydrator or survey), opex-fixed, capacity where printed (VRU Mcf/d, dehydrator MMcf/d, compressor hp, glycol circulation gal/hr), lifetime, emissions-reduction-potential. Gas saved and paybacks are in _measures (not loaded); baseline leak and emission rates, partner case totals and component cost tables are in _other-values. Price year 2006 (Nelson-Farrar February 2006 index) unless the document states another (2000 for gas processing DI&M; 2010 for the 2011 liquids-unloading study); partner cases keep their own years. Most costs are per installation with no gas throughput printed, so they carry no CAPACITY BASIS and cannot be put per GJ without a throughput. Full per-document notes and source defects in epa_2006_lessons-learned_natural-gas-star_notes.md. Extracted 2026-10-02 by four agents, every figure checked on the page image.

Many internal inconsistencies (listed per document in _notes.md); the main ones: dry seals box paybacks ignore the O&M saving the footnote includes, and Exhibit 5 seal cost does not multiply out; VRU summary box value of gas contradicts Exhibit 6; plunger lift capex labelled per year; liquids-unloading Exhibit 11 production value 220,000 vs 400,000 by its own footnote; instrument air box cost mixes capex and annual electricity, and Exhibit 9 converts hp to kW by dividing by 0.75; several NPVs are discounted one period too many; methane vs whole-gas volumes are mixed in several boxes; gas processing DI&M prints a 2006 Nelson-Farrar box but is in 2000 dollars.
